# TokenLens

> Typed model metadata and cost/context helpers for LLM applications

TokenLens resolves canonical model ids across multiple data sources, normalizes usage payloads, and estimates token costs/context limits with a consistent TypeScript API. Works great with the Vercel AI SDK and remains SDK-agnostic.

## Getting Started

## Key Features

TokenLens provides:
- Canonical model registry with alias resolution across OpenRouter and models.dev
- Usage normalization across providers and SDKs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel AI SDK)
- Fast USD cost estimates based on provider pricing data
- Context window checking and token limit management
- TypeScript-first with strong type safety
- Configurable caching with pluggable adapters

## Installation

```bash
npm i tokenlens
```

## Basic Usage

```typescript
import { computeCostUSD, getContextLimits, describeModel } from "tokenlens";

// Estimate costs
const cost = await computeCostUSD({
  modelId: "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
  usage: { inputTokens: 3_200, outputTokens: 400 },
});

// Check context limits
const limits = await getContextLimits({
  modelId: "anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet",
});

// Get full model details
const details = await describeModel({
  modelId: "openai/gpt-4o",
});
```
